entries.text: I have finished the first batch.
entries.easy_read:
My work is done.
I tell my boss.

entries.text: I am still working on it.
entries.easy_read:
My work is not done.
I am still doing it.

entries.text: I have done about half so far.
entries.easy_read:
Some work is done.
Some work is left.

entries.text: I am running about an hour behind.
entries.easy_read:
My work is slow today.
I need one more hour.
errors: hiding the delay until the deadline

entries.text: I will finish it by four o'clock.
entries.easy_read:
I say when I will finish.
I will be done at four.

entries.text: I have finished. What should I do next?
entries.easy_read:
My work is done.
I ask for new work.

entries.text: I cannot continue because the machine has stopped.
entries.easy_read:
The machine is not working.
I cannot do my work.

entries.text: I have run out of boxes.
entries.easy_read:
There are no boxes left.
I need more boxes.

I say how much I did.
I did forty orders today.

entries.text: I found a problem with this order.
entries.easy_read:
Something is wrong.
I tell my boss.

entries.text: I have checked it twice and it is correct.
entries.easy_read:
I looked at it two times.
It is right.

entries.text: I need a little more time to finish this properly.
entries.easy_read:
I want to do it well.
Please give me more time.

entries.text: I have finished trays one to ten. Trays eleven onward are left.
entries.easy_read:
I did the first ten.
The rest are not done.
The next person can start there.

entries.text: I am ahead of schedule today.
entries.easy_read:
My work is going fast.
I am doing well today.

entries.text: I am waiting for approval before I can continue.
entries.easy_read:
I need a yes from my boss.
Then I can work again.

entries.text: I made a mistake and I am redoing that part.
entries.easy_read:
I did something wrong.
I am doing it again.

entries.text: The delivery has been sent out.
entries.easy_read:
The boxes have gone.
The work is done.

entries.text: This week I completed all my tasks and helped train a new joiner.
entries.easy_read:
I did all my work this week.
I also helped a new person.
